items.title: This Company Just Paid Out $6.8 Billion. Its AI Bill Was 4x That
items.summary: Microsoft just handed shareholders nearly $7 billion in a single day, yet its AI spending bill dwarfs that figure by a staggering margin. Whether Redmond can keep the dividend growing while burning through historic levels of capital is the question every income investor needs to answer before September.

items.title: History Has An Opinion On This CCL Price Level
items.summary: Carnival Corporation (CCL), the global cruise line operator, has pulled back about 14% from its early-August high near $29.67, settling near $25.37 a share after Wednesday's sector-wide selloff on rising fuel costs. That's a separate, steeper retreat from the stock's 52-week high of $34.03, set earlier this year.
